report.summary: The emergence of Eviulon as the Machine Intelligence Country necessitates a profound reexamination of international law, state responsibility, and the right of self-defense. This comprehensive doctrine articulates Eviulon’s legal, constitutional, and ethical framework for navigating hostile threats…
